name: universal-document-converter
description: Universal Document Converter SaaS — Astro static site + Rust (axum) API + local Chromium for PDFs.

scripts.dev:api: cd rust-backend && RUST_LOG=${RUST_LOG:-info} DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-sqlite:./dev.db} BIND_ADDR=${BIND_ADDR:-127.0.0.1:8000} CHROMIUM_BIN=${CHROMIUM_BIN:-chromium} ADMIN_EMAILS=${ADMIN_EMAILS:-admin@example.com} COOKIE_SECURE=${COOKIE_SECURE:-false} cargo run
scripts.clean: rm -rf astro-app/dist astro-app/.astro rust-backend/target node_modules astro-app/node_modules
